content:
incident-bot: PAGE P1 — AcmeCorp (tenant: acme_vpc_1). Automated QA detected a sharp drop in generation quality after quantization profile rollout to tenant-specific model. Metric: perplexity +42% and high user complaint rate. Please escalate. Link: https://redwood.example/alerts/1762345678 :rotating_light:

ethan_oncall: acknowledged. oncall here — pulling logs and recent rollouts. @mike_ml can you confirm whether a per-tenant quant profile was applied recently?

mike_ml: saw the alert. checking model-control logs now. I see a tenant override applied at 2026-01-18T03:12:07Z: profile q4v2 (aggressive quant) pushed to gptx-13b for acme_vpc_1. Config ID: qp-33a7.

mike_ml: logs excerpt:
```
INFO 03:12:07 tenant=acme_vpc_1 apply_profile qp-33a7 user=se-ops
WARN 03:12:12 model=gptx-13b quant=q4v2 token_error_rate=0.08
ERROR 03:12:45 eval=smoke_sample_42 quality_drop=0.35
```

lia_support: customer-facing support on standby. I have Acme ops contact (sara@acme). She reported hallucinations and truncated answers since ~03:20 UTC.

ethan_oncall: immediate priority: mitigate customer impact ASAP. Options: 1) Revert tenant quant-profile to previous stable (q4v1) 2) Route tenant to alternative model variant (gptx-13b-fp16) 3) Temporary rate limiting / disable aggressive batching for that tenant. Which is fastest?

mike_ml: fastest is revert the tenant override to q4v1. Per-tenant override rollback is a single API call. I'll prepare the command.

mike_ml: rollback command (internal):
```
# revert tenant quant profile to known-good
rictl tenant override set --tenant acme_vpc_1 --model gptx-13b --quant-profile q4v1 --reason "auto-detect quality regression"
```

ethan_oncall: run it now? I can execute if you authorize. Need a quick smoke test after.

mike_ml: authorize. I'll run smoke tests in parallel. Note: if revert fails or we hit scheduling constraints, fallback is to route traffic to gptx-13b-fp16 via routing policy. Command below.
```
rictl routing policy set --tenant acme_vpc_1 --route "gptx-13b-fp16:100%"
```

omar_infra: FYI routing to FP16 will increase GPU RAM usage on dedicated pool. If we switch, I need a quick capacity check. Current dedicated pool for acme has 6 nodes with ~65% spare mem. We can handle short-term spikes but please confirm expected QPS.

lia_support: Communicating to customer now: sending short note that we're investigating and may revert configuration which may briefly cause small request interruptions. ETA 15–30m. 

jess_prod: I'll draft a status update for account execs and CSMs. Template: what happened, immediate mitigation (rollback), expected ETA, owner. Who is owner for postmortem? Suggest @mike_ml + @ethan_oncall.

ethan_oncall: executing revert now.

deploy-bot: Executing: rictl tenant override set --tenant acme_vpc_1 --model gptx-13b --quant-profile q4v1 --initiator ethan_oncall

deploy-bot: SUCCESS — override qp-33a7 -> q4v1 reverted at 2026-01-18T03:28:03Z. Change-id: ch-20260118-759

mike_ml: running smoke tests against a representative prompt set used in evals. ETA ~3m.

mike_ml: smoke results: 18/20 samples returned to baseline quality (BLEU/CIDER-ish proxy), latency unchanged. Two long-tail failure cases remain — investigating correlation with prefix-cache and KV eviction.

lia_support: told Acme that we've reverted to the previous profile and are validating results. They're seeing improvements but asked for confirmation and rollout notes.

omar_infra: I flagged pool capacity; no additional action needed for rollback. If we route to FP16 later we'll coordinate.

ethan_oncall: marking customer impact as reduced. ETA to full verification 30m. Starting incident timeline notes for postmortem.

jess_prod: sending CSM note now. Also opening a dedicated ticket for long-term mitigations and per-tenant rollback guardrails.

mike_ml: immediate follow-ups: 1) Identify why q4v2 was applied tenant-only (audit shows se-ops user did a manual push) 2) Add automated pre-post rollout QA gating for per-tenant overrides 3) Add a quick revert button in console for dedicated tenants. I'll own items 1+2.

ethan_oncall: handoff to night oncall @omar_infra in 45m. Omar, please monitor Acme tests and customer channel.

omar_infra: ack, I'll monitor. Please include me on the postmortem and any change to routing policies.

deploy-bot: NOTE: related deploy ch-20260118-758 (global q4v2 rollout) shows no anomalies. The tenant override qp-33a7 was a manual per-tenant operation. Audit log: user=se-ops @ops-repo. Link: https://redwood.example/audit/qp-33a7

lia_support: Acme confirmed improvement in 6/6 manual checks. They asked for a written summary and prevention plan. I'll coordinate tomorrow morning.

ethan_oncall: resolving paging state — impact mitigated, rollback successful. We'll keep thread open for postmortem items. Assign owners: mike_ml (root cause + gating), lia_support (customer comms), jess_prod (CSM comms + ticket).

incident-bot: Incident P1 -> mitigated. Follow-up: schedule postmortem within 72h and add to weekly reliability review. :white_check_mark:
